nonBlockingObservations.title: Qualify the outside-lane failure claim after an interrupted lane
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The lane-owned delete/build/write/run/delete sequence and digest comparison establish the intended fixture binding for a normally executed lane, including reused build artifacts. They do not establish that every invocation outside the lane finds no file: the plan itself permits a path file to remain after a killed lane. A direct test invocation before the next lane can read that file and pass the digest check if the fixture bytes are unchanged. The next lane deletes it and restores its own binding. This does not block the lane-scoped fixture design or the scratch amendment.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Describe direct Cargo invocation as unsupported and guaranteed to fail when the handoff file is absent, rather than universally rejected. Explicitly retain the interrupted-lane exception; if rejection outside an active lane is desired, add a separate active-invocation binding in the implementation.
